The Tire Service Technician position is essential to our business. This person must be able to properly dismount, mount, balance, and repair Commercial Vehicle and Medium Truck tires. Employees will be responsible for all aspects of tire and related service and repair for off-the-road equipment (construction, earthmoving, mining, farm etc.) as well as other duties as assigned by the manager.

s.h: HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT -
s.t:
Mount/Dismount/Install tires & tire/wheel assemblies
Load/Unload tires on and off trucks
Repair Tires
Follow established procedures to inspect tires and wheels before and after service.
Determine repairable tire conditions and make such repairs.
Review work orders and discuss work with supervisors.
Document work performed accurately and according to company policy.
Operate heavy-duty tire service equipment and tools including boom cranes, cribbing, jacks, compressors, and electric and hydraulic equipment.
Unbolt and re-bolt wheels from/to equipment, using lug wrenches and other hand and power tools.
Mount and dismount any type of off-the-road tire including but not limited to multi-piece rims.
Perform emergency road service calls on nights and/or weekends on a rotating basis.
Proper maintenance of assigned service vehicle including an appearance as well as onboard service equipment and tools.
Comply with OSHA regulations and safety requirements pertaining to this position.

s.h: WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE -
s.t:
Must be 18 years or older
Valid Driver’s License
Ability to pass a DOT physical
The ability to work in a fast-paced, customer service-oriented environment.
Ability to work on a team and independently
Ability to communicate, verbally and written, clearly and professionally with co-workers and management.
Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

High School Diploma or equivalent
1-2 years of tire service technician experience
CDL License a plus
TIA certification

Work hours are generally 7-5 Monday – Friday. Saturday and evenings as needed; may have little to no advance notice.
Safety is our highest priority and safety procedures/guidelines must be followed.
This position operates in all types of indoor and outdoor work environments, therefore exposure to heat and cold is to be expected.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, bend, climb, lift, and walk.
Required to handle hazardous materials and wear various forms of protective equipment (safety shoes, gloves, protective eyewear, etc.). Comply with OSHA regulations and safety requirements.
Required to lift 75-100 lbs. routinely; may be required to occasionally lift up to 150 lbs. individually.

Paid Time Off
Employee Discounts, including tire discounts
Employer 401(k) Match
Diverse & Inclusive Work Environment
Employee Assistance Program
Future Growth Opportunities

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher ’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher ’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world.

Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year.

From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
The Field Service Engineer for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics is responsible for supporting the needs of our client, which directly impacts patient health and overall well-being.
This position is part of the Service Organization located in Wichita, KS and will be fully remote covering the areas of Kansa Nebraska, Iowa, Kansas, and Missouri. At Beckman Coulter, our vision is to relentlessly reimagine healthcare, one diagnosis at a time.

You will be a part of the Field Service Team reporting to the Field Service Manager and responsible for troubleshooting, installation, preventative maintenance, and service repair needs on Beckman Coulter equipment. This position services the Automation and Chemistry.

If you thrive in a fast-paced role and want to work to build a world-class service organization—read on.

s.h: In this role, you will have the opportunity to
s.t:
Under minimal direction, complete troubleshooting, installation, validation, preventative maintenance, modifications, and service repair needs on Beckman Coulter equipment including providing excellent and efficient service to Beckman Coulter’s customers, along with technical training on products.
Maintain accurate customer service logs and internal service records, order repair parts, and adhere to cycle times. Utilize business systems such as OBI, Sales Force, and SharePoint for Service Call Planning and advancing team goals
Communicate with various levels of internal and external customers, recognizing and addressing their unique needs. Foster collaboration by assisting with the training of newer Field Service Engineers

s.h: The essential requirements of the job include
s.t:
Associate degree (prefer technical, biomedical, instrumentation, electrical engineering or related) or equivalent military experience or High School diploma
1-year experience diagnosing and repairing mechanical, electromechanical, robotics, electronic equipment, and/or instrumentation
Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:
Ability to travel , 10% overnight, within territory including Nebraska, North Dakota, Minnesota, Iowa
Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record
Ability to lift, move, or carry equipment up to 50lb (tools, replacement parts, consumables etc.).

s.h: It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in
s.t:
3+ years’ experience of advanced trouble shooting
Developing relationships with internal and external customers to foster positive partnership and enhance likelihood of customer satisfaction and retention.
At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement.

This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics can provide.
The hourly range for this role is $34.00/hour - $38.00/hour . This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.
This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.
We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Join our team and become a part of a continuously expanding and financially sound multinational conglomerate - Goddard Enterprises Limited (GEL). McBride (Caribbean) Limited – a member of GEL, is a household aerosol manufacturing company that sells its products in 30 countries across the Caribbean and Latin America. We are looking for a talented individual who shares our values to join our team as Maintenance Technician . This position reports to the Maintenance Supervisor.

The primary duties and responsibilities of the Maintenance Technicia n include but are not limited to:
Conduct production line change overs and equipment setups.
Troubleshoot and repair mechanical, electrical and pneumatic faults on production and ancillary equipment.
Perform planned preventive maintenance on all plant and equipment in accordance with the maintenance schedule.
Conduct electrical fault finding, repairs and minor installations on plant and equipment.
Complete and close out work orders in the maintenance management system.
Assist with the installation and commissioning of new equipment and plant improvement projects.
Perform fabrication works in support of repairs and projects.
Maintain plant utilities and services, including compressed air systems.
Check safety and emergency equipment to ensure functionality as scheduled.
Complete reports and process documentation.
Maintain a clean and safe working area and work strictly within the site health, safety and environmental procedures.

City & Guilds Technical Certificate or equivalent technical qualification from an accredited institution. Electrical certification preferred.
Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in a similar capacity.
Knowledge of electrical equipment, industrial automation and pneumatic controls would be an asset.
Welding skills and experience in a flammable manufacturing environment would be an asset.
Strong analytical, problem solving and decision-making skills.
Excellent written and oral communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Ability to be flexible and work overtime as required.
Ability to work effectively with others and independentl y.

An attractive remuneration and benefits package is being offered commensurate with the candidate’s experience. Our benefits package includes participation in the Group Life, Medical Insurance and Pension Schemes, opportunities for training & development. Through our Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP) you have the opportunity to be a part-owner of GEL (where eligible)—let’s grow toget her!

1 Ausbildungsplätze per August 2027 Als Lernende:r Fachmann/\-frau Betriebsunterhalt in der Fachrichtung Werkdienst arbeitest du vorwiegend draussen und bist "wetterfest". Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören schwergewichtig der bauliche und betriebliche Unterhalt auf dem Areal des Flughafens Zürich.

Neben Grünflächen und Grünanlagen pflegst du die Pisten, Wege und Strassen im und um den Flughafen. Dazu gehören die Unkrautbekämpfung, die Reparatur von Pisten\- und Belagsschäden sowie der Winterdienst. Weitere Informationen zur Ausbildung als Fachmann/\-frau Betriebsunterhalt EFZ in unserem Unternehmen findest du auf unserer Internetseite.
Deine Jobdestination
Du arbeitest überwiegend im Freien und meisterst jede Wetterlage, während du für den baulichen und betrieblichen Unterhalt des Flughafengeländes sorgst
Du kümmerst dich um die sorgfältige Pflege und Instandhaltung der Grünflächen und Grünanlagen, die den Flughafen umgeben und verschönern
Du hältst die Pisten, Wege und Strassen im und um den Flughafen in einwandfreiem Zustand, indem du regelmässig Reparaturen und Instandhaltungsarbeiten durchführst
Deine Skills im Gepäck
Die obligatorische Schulzeit auf Sekundarstufe hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen
Du hast Freude an praktischen Tätigkeiten grösstenteils in Gebäuden aber auch im Freien
Dein handwerkliches Geschick, dein gutes technisches Verständnis und deine praktische Veranlagung zeichnen dich aus
Deine Arbeitsweise zeichnet sich durch Selbständigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein aus
Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Liebe zum logischen Denken gehören zu deinen Stärken
Du bist flexibel, belastbar und verfügst über eine hohe Lern\- und Leistungsbereitschaft
Du drückst dich gerne und gewandt in Deutsch in Wort und Schrift aus

Gratis ZVV\-Bonuspass, GA\-Beteiligung und Parkplatzmöglichkeiten

Raum für deine Bedürfnisse
27 Tage Ferien, 13 Monatslöhne und Möglichkeit zusätzliche Ferientage für spezielle Leistungen zu erhalten
Gemeinsam feiern
Spezielle Einführungswoche, jährliches Lernendenlager, Elternabende, Weihnachts\- und Lehrabschlussfeier
Auspowern \& runterfahren
Eigenes kostenloses Sportangebot von Bootcamp bis zum Yoga. Vergünstigtes Fitnessabo am Flughafen

Prämien NBU und KTG übernehmen wir, Rabatt auf Kollektivversicherung und bei Unfall privatversichert

· Un emploi saisonnier varié de mi-octobre à mi-mars.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. This is a Night Shift 7pm-7:30am. 3-2-2 Schedule (rotating every other week)

You will be responsible for performing a high building systems and equipment operation and maintenance for all facility and utility related equipment. This includes equipment that supplies critical and emergency utilities for manufacturing areas and all the local support functions at the Drug Delivery and Penicillin buildings.
This position ensures equipment is well maintained by performing on time completion of Preventive and Predictive Maintenance, monitoring of building systems and alarms to respond and address conditions before they result in an impact to plant operations.

Baxter is passionate about saving and sustaining lives by finding solutions to sophisticated problems. Every single day, the manufacturing team strives to create quality products for our customers—and are sometimes met with unforeseen issues to tackle. The high-caliber talent at Baxter meets these challenges head-on, as a team, to create products with the customer's needs top-of-mind.
We provide opportunities for you to continue to learn through training, conferences, certifications, and support for advanced degrees. Growth from role to role or level to level is encouraged and is supported by management to ensure employees are consistently engaged with their work.

You will work independently to complete maintenance activities while continuously building your technical knowledge and skills through training and hands-on experience. You will take a proactive approach to safety, lead by example, and follow plant and corporate procedures related to critical facility systems, equipment, GMP, and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) to support reliable manufacturing operations.
Responsible for daily checks and maintenance activities in the facility areas.
Conducts preventive and planned maintenance activities as the need arises.
Responsible for knowing and following all safety and compliance requirements and maintaining cleanliness within work area.
Follows written instructions such as standard operating procedures and preventive maintenance instructions and performs proper record keeping following Good Documentation Practices (GDP) including accurate and timely documentation.
Trouble-shoots, repairs and maintains a wide range of equipment, such as boilers, air compressor, stills, air handlers, motors, programmable logic controller (PLC) systems (Siemens, Allen Bradley, etc.), temperature controllers, variable speed drives, and electrical systems up to 480v, 3ph.
Performs tasks such as equipment relocations, crating or uncrating of parts, mechanical adjustments and alignments, identifying and ordering of spare parts, documenting all work, clean-up before leaving job, attending relevant training and meetings.
Participates continuous improvement projects and upgrades.
Personal protective equipment must be worn in accordance with all safety requirements.
Periodic work in clean room environments wearing appropriate gowning.

A candidate must not be allergic to Penicillin and Cephalosporin or their related products and minerals.
High school diploma or GED equivalent required, technical certifications a plus.
Associates degree in a technical discipline or above a plus.

s.h: 3 or more years maintenance experience preferred.
s.t:
You will have experience with basic hand tools and electrical meters.
Show an active curiosity about self-improvement and training, including in maintenance techniques and new equipment technologies.
Strong troubleshooting skills.
Ability to read and understand mechanical, electrical drawings, flowcharts, and/or other technical drawings.
Experience with Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). Maximo preferred.
Electrical knowledge and experience with AC/DC motors and drives, electrical systems up to 480V 3-phase, relays, switches, sensors, valves, and servo motors.
Work with limited amount of supervision, have strong verbal and written communication skills.
Good documentation skills and strong digital literacy.
Ability to work under pressure and respond with a sense of urgency.
Ability to implement energy improvement projects.
Light machining skills not required but a plus.
Prior experience working in an FDA regulated environment preferred.

The actual salary may vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills/experience, time in the role, business line, and geographic/office location.
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

As a Senior Field Service Engineer, you are the senior technical authority in the field for keeping Orbem's systems running reliably, at customer sites and in our own labs. You own the end-to-end resolution of complex, unplanned service incidents from start to finish, acting as the escalation point when others can't crack a problem.

Own end-to-end diagnosis and resolution of complex, previously unresolved, or urgent service incidents at customer sites and in our internal labs, without needing to escalate for a resolution.

Thoughtfully tailor maintenance and troubleshooting approaches to local site conditions, documenting the rationale for any deviation from standard procedure.
Own the creation and continuous improvement of maintenance and service SOPs/checklists, driving the PDCA cycle for the servicing function.
Mentor and coach junior Field Engineers/Field Service Engineers on troubleshooting best practices and technical judgment.
Lead Site Visit Checklist execution and technical problem-solving during installation and upgrade projects when deployed as senior surge capacity.

You have significant, hands-on experience diagnosing and resolving complex electrical, mechanical, or automation issues in an industrial or field-service environment, ideally including experience as the senior/primary troubleshooter on a team.
You have strong working knowledge of electrical diagrams, AutoCAD, and automation/networking concepts (PLC, Modbus, or similar).
You are comfortable being the final escalation point for urgent, unplanned technical issues, making autonomous, well-reasoned decisions under time pressure without waiting for sign-off.
You have experience mentoring, training, or informally guiding less experienced technical colleagues.
You have experience creating or improving technical SOPs, checklists, or maintenance processes, not just executing them.
You are willing to travel extensively and can react to short-notice, urgent dispatch needs, including occasional weekend or after-hours support.
You hold, or are willing to obtain, relevant electrical/technical certifications (e.g. EFK-equivalent).
You are fluent in English (written and spoken), our working language.
You are fluent in Italian (written and spoken), enabling direct, seamless support for our growing base of Italian customers and sites.
What Makes You Stand Out
Experience servicing MRI systems, medical devices, or other highly regulated industrial equipment; a track record of standing up a maintenance function or service SOPs from scratch in a scale-up environment.
Additional working proficiency in German and/or Spanish is a strong plus, further extending our on-site language coverage across Europe.

The position serves as a Collections Management Technician II and is located in the Stack Management Unit, Collections Maintenance and Stack Management Section, of the Collections Management Division (CMD), Preservation Directorate (PRES), Discovery and Preservation Services (DPS) within the Library Collections and Services Group (LCSG) at the Library of Congress (LC).

As a Collection Management Technician, you will: Follow extensive library rules, procedures and operations, retrieve materials from the collection. Apply judgement in retrieving materials. Receive retrieval requests through a number of methods including paper call slips, Automated Call Slip (ACS) and/or other automated request systems.

With some projects, follow general guidelines on what to pull, and must adhere to these guidelines which might include criteria such as item condition, date of publication, or format.

Follow a number of established procedures and specific guidelines available in the form of extensive library procedures, rules, and operations, perform an array of activities involved in maintaining the collections, including ensuring that collections are in the proper order, safe from hazards and readily retrievable when requested.

Use judgment to identify and select the most appropriate procedure to use, choose from among several established alternatives, or decide which precedent actions to follow as a model. Refer situations requiring significant judgment to the supervisor or others for guidance or resolution.

Arrange, sort and re-shelve materials returned to the stacks according to the prescribed order for that portion of the collection. Maintain assigned areas to ensure that each item is in proper order according to collections management and maintenance guidelines for each collection.

Frequent shelf reading of the collections, i.e., ensuring that the items on the shelves are in proper order, is a critical component of collections maintenance.

Use multiple shelving and classification arrangements including LC Classification, fixed location arrangement and others utilized by CMD to ensure that collections are properly shelved, arranged and accessible for use.

Use an in-depth or broad knowledge of a body of library regulations, procedures, and policies related collections retrieval to perform procedural duties or technical operation of limited scope and difficulty.

Provide enhanced book retrieval service, including quick searches for all Not-on-Shelf (NoS) responses for patrons, staff and priority clients, primarily CRS staff and Congressional patrons.

Identify and remove items suspected of containing errors in labeling and/or cataloging and forward items to the Preservation Directorate, the Acquisitions and Bibliographic Access Directorate, or other Library units for further determination or disposition.

Utilize and operate the Library's automated material handling systems used to sort and process collections. Operate the equipment as well as perform preventative maintenance on the machine(s).

Perform an array of preservation-related activities in support of stabilizing the collections and preventing further damage The position description number for this position is 429735. The salary range indicated reflects the locality pay adjustments for the Washington, D.C., Metropolitan area.

The incumbent of this position will work a fixed work schedule (8:00am-4:30pm.) This is a non-supervisory, bargaining unit position. Relocation expenses will not be authorized for the person(s) selected under this vacancy announcement.
Applicants must have had progressively responsible experience and training sufficient in scope and quality to furnish them with an acceptable level of the following knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the position without more than normal supervision.

Knowledge of library collections maintenance practices and procedures.** Ability to use computerized databases and search tools.** Knowledge of proper library collection retrieval processes and procedures. Ability to plan work and meet deadlines. Ability to interact collaboratively with others.

Ability to communicate effectively other than in writing.

## TECHNICIEN DE MAINTENANCE ÉLECTROMÉCANIQUE - MOTEURS ÉLECTRIQUES ##
**Canton de Neuchâtel**
**Un moteur tombe en panne. Votre premier réflexe est de chercher pourquoi, pas simplement de remplacer la pièce ?**
Alors nous devrions nous parler.
Dans le cadre d'un recrutement pour l'un de nos partenaires industriels, nous recherchons un **technicien de maintenance électromécanique** capable d'intervenir sur des moteurs électriques et des équipements industriels, aussi bien sur la partie **électrique que mécanique**.
Ici, nous recherchons avant tout quelqu'un qui sait **diagnostiquer, démonter, comprendre, réparer et remettre en service**.
### Votre quotidien ###

* Le diagnostic de pannes électromécaniques
* Le démontage et remontage de moteurs électriques
* La recherche de défauts électriques et mécaniques
* Le contrôle des stators, rotors, roulements et différents composants
* Le remplacement et l'ajustement des éléments défectueux
* Les mesures électriques et contrôles d'isolement
* Les essais, contrôles et validation après intervention
* Les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective
* La remise en état d'équipements électromécaniques industriels
### Le profil que nous recherchons ###
Vous êtes issu d'une formation d'**électromécanicien, automaticien, mécanicien-électricien** ou d'une formation technique équivalente.
Mais au-delà du diplôme, c'est surtout votre expérience pratique qui nous intéresse.
Vous êtes à l'aise lorsqu'il faut passer d'un **schéma électrique à un roulement**, d'une mesure d'isolement à un démontage mécanique, puis comprendre l'origine réelle d'une panne.
Vous travaillez avec méthode, précision et autonomie et vous accordez de l'importance à la qualité du travail réalisé.
### Vous marquez des points supplémentaires si vous connaissez ###
* Les moteurs électriques AC et DC
* Le bobinage ou la réfection de moteurs
* Les systèmes tournants
* Les pompes, ventilateurs ou réducteurs
* Les contrôles électriques et mesures d'isolement
* La maintenance ou la révision électromécanique en atelier
**Vous n'avez pas besoin de maîtriser l'ensemble de ces domaines.**
Nous recherchons avant tout une personne disposant de **bonnes bases électromécaniques, d'une véritable logique de diagnostic et de l'envie de comprendre ce qu'elle répare.**
### Pourquoi cette opportunité ? ###
Parce qu'il ne s'agit pas d'un poste de maintenance où l'on se contente de changer des composants.
Vous rejoignez un environnement dans lequel **le savoir-faire technique, le diagnostic et la réparation ont encore une vraie valeur**.

* Une activité technique variée
* Des équipements industriels différents
* Un atelier disposant d'un véritable savoir-faire
* Une équipe expérimentée
* Un poste stable
* Des compétences techniques reconnues et valorisées
### Vous vous reconnaissez ? ###
Vous aimez ouvrir une machine pour comprendre ce qui ne fonctionne plus.
Vous préférez **trouver la panne plutôt que changer des pièces au hasard**.
Et lorsqu'un moteur repart après votre intervention, vous savez exactement pourquoi.
**Alors votre profil nous intéresse.**
### Candidature ###
Chaque candidature est étudiée avec **attention, discrétion et confidentialité** dans le cadre de notre activité de conseil et d'accompagnement des entreprises industrielles.

s.h: Your mission Welcome to your new opportunity with Sungrow!
s.t:
As an EV Field Service Engineer , you will play a crucial role in supporting our customers and ensuring the reliable operation of Sungrow EV charging solutions across the UK. You will be a trusted technical partner, delivering remote and on-site support while helping customers get the most from our products.
This is an exciting opportunity to become one of our early EV engineering specialists in the UK. You will have significant scope for career growth, including the potential to help build and lead a local EV engineering team in the future.
Please note that this role involves up to 60% travel , with approximately three days per week spent on customer sites.
Your ResponsibilitiesCustomer Service Device Monitoring & Remote Diagnostics
Proactively monitor commissioned EV chargers remotely to identify potential issues.
Diagnose and resolve charger malfunctions, communication issues, and electrical, electronic, or control-system faults.
Troubleshoot communication with local inverters, energy meters, onboard controllers, and customer SCADA systems.
Clearly explain issues and resolutions to customers, building confidence in Sungrow products.
Implement proactive actions—including remote reboots, configuration changes, and firmware updates—to maximise fleet availability and minimise downtime.
Commissioning & Field Troubleshooting
Align commissioning activities for new EV chargers with customer requirements.
Provide clear remote guidance and support for commissioning tasks.
Plan and coordinate on-site commissioning with installers, electricians, platform technicians, and other stakeholders.
Integrate EV chargers into customer systems, including local grids, EMS controllers, OCPP backends, and shared-meter arrangements.
Configure systems to ensure safe, reliable, and seamless operation.
Lead on-site troubleshooting for complex technical issues and replace faulty components in compliance with electrical safety regulations.
Specialised Tool Expertise
Develop strong expertise in Sungrow monitoring and diagnostic tools.
Use these tools to identify potential issues early and support proactive maintenance.
Product Improvement & Data Management Quality Issue Reporting
Identify and document recurring quality issues for Product, R&D, and Manufacturing teams.
Contribute practical field insights that support continuous product improvement.
Database Management
Maintain accurate customer, service, and issue records in internal systems.
Data Processing Enhancement
Support improvements to internal data-processing methods and platforms to strengthen performance evaluation and fault detection.
Your profile Hands-on experience in an electrotechnical or electrical engineering field, with strong practical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
A genuine interest in green technology and EV charging infrastructure.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking and experience using command-line tools to diagnose network issues.
Experience with OCPP and Modbus-TCP communication protocols is highly desirable.
Ability to interpret electrical single-line diagrams to diagnose system performance and faults.
Technical proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or professional statistical-analysis software; Linux knowledge is a strong advantage.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to support non-technical customers in troubleshooting situations.
English proficiency at B2 level or above is required. Additional European languages are advantageous.
Must be based in the United Kingdom and able to travel extensively across the country, with occasional international travel for training or troubleshooting.
Existing right to work in the UK is required; visa sponsorship or relocation may be considered for exceptional candidates.

Stellenbeschreibung
Die ideale Lehre für handwerklich geschickte junge Erwachsene mit Begeisterung für Haustechnik!

Pflege und Instandhaltung von Gebäuden und Grünanlagen
Die Ausbildung dauert 3 Jahre.
Profil
Du liebst es, dich handwerklich sowie körperlich zu betätigen, und bist sehr geschickt dabei. Gleichzeitig hast du ein praktisch\-technisches Verständnis sowie Freude am Planen und Organisieren und interessierst dich für Haustechnik. Mit deinem Dienstleistungsbewusstsein und deiner Offenheit unterstützt du dein Umfeld gekonnt.
Du brauchst für diese Berufslehre einen obligatorischen Schulabschluss.

Afin de renforcer notre département Facilities & Services chez SICPA, nous recherchons un(e):
**Technicien de maintenance**
**Mission générale**
Le Technicien de maintenance assure de manière autonome et proactive l-exploitation, la maintenance, le dépannage et le suivi des infrastructures techniques du site de Florissant, comprenant notamment les installations desservant les laboratoires, le Data Center et les infrastructures générales du site.

Il est responsable des installations techniques depuis leur production jusqu-à leur distribution ou point de raccordement aux équipements utilisateurs, dans le respect des règles de sécurité, des normes et des prescriptions en vigueur.
**Domaines techniques concernés:**
**Électricité**
* Production et distribution électrique du site.
* Maintenance et dépannage des installations électriques jusqu-au point de raccordement.
* Intervention selon les compétences et autorisations requises.
**Sanitaire et chauffage**
* Production et distribution de chaleur et d-eau.
* Maintenance des réseaux, pompes, vannes et installations associées.
* Diagnostic et dépannage des installations.
**Production et distribution de froid**
* Production de froid et installations associées.
* Réseaux et circuits de distribution.
* Pompes, vannes et équipements périphériques.
* Suivi des paramètres de fonctionnement et dépannage.
**Ventilation**
* Exploitation et maintenance des installations de ventilation et d-extraction d-air.
* Ventilation des locaux, notamment des laboratoires et des zones techniques.
* Suivi des débits, températures, pressions et paramètres de fonctionnement.
* Diagnostic et dépannage des installations.
**Air comprimé**
* Production et distribution d-air comprimé.
* Maintenance des compresseurs et réseaux de distribution.
* Surveillance des installations et recherche d-anomalies ou de fuites.
**Automation et supervision**
* Exploitation et suivi des systèmes d-automation et de supervision des infrastructures techniques.
* Surveillance des alarmes et des paramètres des installations.
* Diagnostic des défauts et interventions dans la limite des compétences et autorisations.
**Autonomie et organisation**
Le Technicien de maintenance travaille de manière autonome et organise son activité quotidienne en fonction des priorités, des urgences et des besoins du site.
Il assure le suivi des interventions, identifie les anomalies et propose des solutions adaptées. Il collabore avec les entreprises externes ou les spécialistes lorsque les compétences nécessaires dépassent son périmètre d-intervention.
**Service de piquet**
Participation au service de piquet environ une fois par mois, lorsque l-effectif de l-équipe est au complet, afin d-assurer la continuité de fonctionnement des infrastructures techniques des trois sites : Florissant, Campus et Bussigny.
**Responsabilité principale**
Le Technicien de maintenance contribue directement à la disponibilité, à la fiabilité, à la sécurité et à la pérennité des infrastructures techniques, dans son domaine de compétence et jusqu-aux points de distribution ou de raccordement.

* Capacité à effectuer des interventions préventives, correctives et curatives.
* Aptitude à travailler avec des entreprises externes et des spécialistes lorsque nécessaire.
